name: Phase 10
summary: Contract rummy card game where players race to complete ten specific meld phases in order.
rules_text: Phase 10 uses two standard 52-card decks including jokers. 2-6 players are dealt a hand each round from a shared shuffled draw pile with a discard pile. A phase chart defines ten required melds, for example sets of same rank, runs of consecutive numbers, and combinations thereof. On a turn a player draws from draw or discard pile and discards one card. If they hold the exact cards for their current phase they may lay the phase face up. Once a phase is laid they may hit by adding cards to any laid phases on the table that fit the meld pattern. The hand ends when one player empties their hand by melding and hitting and discarding. That player advances to the next phase next hand and scores zero. Others keep their current phase and score penalty points for cards left in hand. First to complete phase ten wins; if multiple do in same hand lowest total penalty wins.
rating_reason: Contract rummy, specific phases, hidden hands, strategic
